marketSnapshot.headline: Underwrite any rental in 60 seconds — without the spreadsheet.
marketSnapshot.body: TrueCap was built for a fast first-pass screen with editable assumptions. Paste an address to review cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, cash flow, Deal Score, and a verdict. Pro adds Max Offer, sensitivity, projections, and modeled exits. The examples below are illustrations, not verified properties or investment recommendations.

dealSpotter.body: Illustrative $420k duplex with both units entered at $1,950 rent. TrueCap calculates cap rate, cash-on-cash, monthly cash flow, and DSCR from the entered and benchmark assumptions. Pro can add a 10-year projection and sensitivity view. Replace taxes, rent, condition, and expenses with property-specific evidence before relying on the result.

dealSpotter.address: Indianapolis, IN — Mars Hill SFR example
dealSpotter.body: Illustrative $185k 3/1.5 ranch at $1,475 entered rent. TrueCap can start with a HUD area-rent benchmark, an owner-occupied FRED rate benchmark, and a state tax estimate; those are not property comps, a loan quote, or a local tax bill. Verify each assumption before deciding whether the property deserves deeper review.

Illustrative $245k 3-unit with a 9.1% seller headline cap rate. Recalculate using explicit vacancy, CapEx, expense, and financing assumptions. A modeled 1.04 DSCR may miss some program targets, but lender definitions and requirements vary and clearing any threshold does not guarantee approval.

blogFeature.title: How to underwrite a rental property in 60 seconds
blogFeature.excerpt: The five numbers that decide whether a rental deal pencils — cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, monthly net cash flow, and 10-year IRR. The triage framework every serious investor uses before opening the full underwrite.

qa.question: Why should I use TrueCap instead of my spreadsheet (or BiggerPockets, or DealCheck, or Mashvisor)?
qa.answer: Three reasons to test it against your current workflow. (1) Speed: address lookup can provide property details plus labeled HUD, FRED, and state-level starting benchmarks, subject to coverage. (2) Transparent math: cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, cash flow, and assumptions stay visible and editable. (3) Paid decision tools: Max Offer, sensitivity, projections, modeled exits, reports, and repeat-deal workflows. TrueCap is an estimate and screening aid, not a source of property-specific truth or a substitute for your spreadsheet, inspection, lender, appraiser, CPA, or attorney.
